spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow images to breathe. Prioritize negative space in marketing pages.

surfaces.card: bg-white border border-[#E5E0D8] transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-floating

marketing_pages.approach: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Asymmetrical layouts. No Shadcn wrappers for core layouts.
marketing_pages.hero: Full-width or 90vw rounded-3xl container, text overlay with gradient, high-quality image.
marketing_pages.trip_catalog: Bento grid mode A. Mix of square and tall portrait cards. Large high-res images.
marketing_pages.gallery: Masonry or staggered grid. generous gap.
marketing_pages.cta: Solid terracotta button, generous padding (px-8 py-4), rounded-full, with hover lift.

dashboard.approach: Shadcn components heavily utilized (Tables, Forms, Dialogs). Dense spacing.
dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + main content area. Strict geometric alignment.
dashboard.forms: Use Shadcn forms. Clear labels, inline validation.

image_urls.description: Group hugging at mountain overlook during sunset
People relaxing at sunset on mountain
Group standing on top of mountain

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: Always ensure text contrast remains accessible on hover. E.g., hover:bg-[#A64D31] hover:text-white
accessibility_and_interactions.test_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write ALL content and dummy copy in SPANISH.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for marketing pages for a premium touch, and Lucide for the admin panel.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Install and apply 'Cormorant Garamond' from Google Fonts for headings, and 'Manrope' for body.
For the trip catalog, prioritize large, inspiring imagery. Use the provided destination URLs.
The reservation form should NOT process payments. It should collect user details and selected trip, and include a CTA to open WhatsApp or send an email.
Admin dashboard must include views to manage trips, reservations, gallery photos, and testimonials.
Apply the 'hero_overlay' gradient over the hero image instead of a flat black overlay to preserve image visibility.
All cards must have a border (#E5E0D8) to provide crisp edges rather than relying solely on shadows.
